### Problem

The report in #3565 describes a defect, and the reproduction confirmed it: a fixed test written from the report fails on the default branch at `322322f8e3839fd0d13cb8767324848158b20817` (https://github.com/DiluxOne/diluxone-test/actions/runs/44848791682).

Reproduction test: `tests/repro/test_issue_3565.py`, SHA-256 `ffa2f8916d5c3749a155df5c729cd88212be889b82add7f78d9c480aca69c8f4`, on the branch `test/repro-issue-3565`.

Reproduction way: `fixed`, run by scripts/repro-run.sh as `{"junit":"build/repro-3565.xml","minutes":5,"run":"python3 tests/repro/test_issue_3565.py","test":"tests/repro/test_issue_3565.py"}`.

The test is the specification: it asserts what the report expected. It was written from an outsider's text, so it runs only the way it was written, in the reproduction's sandbox (scripts/repro-run.sh: the way's setup before the test is in the tree, then the test alone as a user of its own, with no environment, no secrets and no network but the machine's), never in the autopilot's working tree.

### Scope

- Fix the defect the reproduction test exercises, in the code it exercises.
- Add the reproduction test to the default branch, exactly as written.

### Out of scope

- Changing, moving, skipping or deleting the reproduction test: it is the evidence, and gate G7 checks its SHA-256.
- Any other behaviour the report mentions that the test does not exercise: a new issue.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given the reproduction test tests/repro/test_issue_3565.py exactly as written, when it runs on the fix, then it passes, where it failed on 322322f8e383.

### Criticality

Normal
